name: term-server
description: A fast, secure, Rust-powered web terminal workspace.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:e2e: npm run build:e2e:client && npm run build:e2e:server && npm run build:e2e:fixture
scripts.test: cargo test && vitest run && npm run test:release
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:e2e && sh -c 'has_project=0; for arg do case "$arg" in --project|--project=*) has_project=1;; esac; done; if [ "$has_project" -eq 0 ]; then set -- --project=chromium-pr "$@"; fi; exec playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts "$@"' --
scripts.test:e2e:headed: npm run build:e2e && sh -c 'has_project=0; for arg do case "$arg" in --project|--project=*) has_project=1;; esac; done; if [ "$has_project" -eq 0 ]; then set -- --project=chromium-pr "$@"; fi; exec playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts --headed "$@"' --
scripts.test:e2e:debug: npm run build:e2e && sh -c 'has_project=0; for arg do case "$arg" in --project|--project=*) has_project=1;; esac; done; if [ "$has_project" -eq 0 ]; then set -- --project=chromium-pr "$@"; fi; exec playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts --debug "$@"' --
scripts.test:e2e:nightly: npm run build:e2e && sh -c 'has_project=0; for arg do case "$arg" in --project|--project=*) has_project=1;; esac; done; if [ "$has_project" -eq 0 ]; then set -- --project=chromium-nightly --project=firefox-nightly --project=webkit-nightly "$@"; fi; exec playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts "$@"' --
scripts.test:e2e:soak: npm run build:e2e && sh -c 'has_project=0; for arg do case "$arg" in --project|--project=*) has_project=1;; esac; done; if [ "$has_project" -eq 0 ]; then set -- --project=soak "$@"; fi; exec playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts "$@"' --
scripts.check: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && npm run typecheck && npm run check:terminal-unicode && npm test && npm run build:client
